notes: «حفظناه من في الزهري» (Sufyan memorised it from Zuhri's mouth): Zuhri is a link.
The last level is two Companions who speak together («قالا»); the story of the two litigants is the scene they relay.
Ali's remark «قلت لسفيان» and Sufyan's doubt about Zuhri's wording are remarks on wording, not routes; left out.
